item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00485","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C16","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C11 plausibly supplied the governing drafting framework for the child. It directs uniform agency-specific Emergency Preparedness Orders covering plans and programs for all national emergencies, including attack, and contains a closely matching reservation against implementing plans without further authority. The child converts that framework into a detailed Housing and Home Finance Agency assignment. C16 is a strong secondary structural analogue for its repeated sequence of assessing requirements and resources, formulating plans, setting priorities or allocations, acting as claimant, and coordinating with other agencies. C24 supplies closely related civil-defense machinery and language concerning presidential coordination, shelter, damage assessment, agency agreements, redelegation, and preservation of prior emergency-preparedness assignments, but is less complete as a drafting template for the child's overall form.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"shall prepare national emergency plans and develop preparedness programs ... designed to develop a state of readiness ... with respect to all conditions of national emergency, including attack upon the United States","parent_excerpt":"shall establish a series of civil-defense and defense-mobilization planning assignments ... designed to provide for the development of civil-defense and defense-mobilization plans and programs ... to meet all conditions of national emergency, including attack upon the United States","explanation":"C11 contains distinctive language and the precise administrative concept that the child implements for a particular agency and subject area."},{"child_excerpt":"Nothing in this order shall be construed as conferring authority ... to put into effect any emergency plan procedure, policy, program, or course of action prepared or developed pursuant to this order. Such authority is reserved to the President.","parent_excerpt":"Nothing in this order ... shall be construed as conferring authority to put into effect any plan, procedure, policy, program, or other course of action prepared or developed pursuant to this order or the National Plan.","explanation":"This is a highly specific, nearly verbatim reservation clause, materially supporting direct drafting reuse from C11."},{"child_excerpt":"Periodically assess assigned resources ... analyze resource estimates in relation to estimated requirements ... Develop standards and priorities ... Prepare plans to claim materials, manpower, equipment, supplies, and services","parent_excerpt":"Assemble and analyze data with respect to requirements ... and with respect to the ability of such systems and facilities to satisfy such requirements ... Administer such priorities ... Act as claimant for materials and manpower","explanation":"C16 provides a parallel sequence of emergency-resource planning functions that appears adapted in the child to housing resources."},{"child_excerpt":"The Director of the Office of Emergency Planning shall advise and assist the President in determining policy for, and assist him in coordinating the performance of functions under this order","parent_excerpt":"The Director of the Office of Civil and Defense Mobilization shall advise and assist the President in ... determining policy for, planning, directing and coordinating ... the total civil defense program","explanation":"C24 supplies closely parallel central policy and coordination machinery later incorporated into the child's functional-guidance provisions."}]}
